findings: Frontend Settings UI missing — The commit lacks changes to HRMS/src/pages/Settings.jsx. Add the Sandwich Leave Policy section with three boolean toggles as specified in the plan and design so administrators can configure the rules.

Breaking API change on LeaveSettingsRequest — The three new fields are marked @NotNull but existing API clients may not send them. Either make the fields nullable in the DTO with defaults applied by the mapper, or document that this is a breaking change requiring a major version bump and coordinate with API consumers.

LeavePaidLopServiceImpl integration gap — The design and verification note both flag that the main repository's PAID/LOP classifier must be updated to read forcedWorkingDays from LeaveRequest and count them as working days even if they fall on weekends. Verify this service exists and add it to the implementation scope or document as a follow-up task.

Empty file Mon-only) in commit — The git diff shows a new empty file Mon-only) at the repository root. This is likely a shell redirect artifact from testing. Delete it and amend the commit or create a cleanup commit.

No validation that forced days are actually weekends — The expandForSandwichLeave() method adds Saturday and Sunday to forcedWorkingDays without verifying they are weekends. This is correct by design (DayOfWeek.FRIDAY guarantees Saturday and Sunday follow), but the code lacks a clarifying comment that the day-of-week check on the trigger date guarantees the forced dates are weekends.
